verdict.rationale: Formant documents a single operator view across multiple fleets and vendors. It also claims real-time telemetry and status updates across the entire fleet, current location and status tracking per robot, and fleet-level dashboards by device group or tag. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing or docs), and in-depth docs specifically on fleet-wide map/location and health views rather than marketing-page claims.
